card.name: Little words in PHP error paths
card.fires_on: Small words like 'in', 'on', 'line' and 'at' in PHP warning messages, right before a file path or line number. Strongest on 'in' after 'No such file or directory'.

modes.label: PHP warning wording
modes.description: The word 'in', 'on' or 'line' inside a PHP error message that points to a file path or line number.
modes.example: failed to open stream: No such file or directory<< in>> /sites/polishlinux.org/wp-content

modes.label: Other 'at' or 'in' in technical text
modes.description: Weaker firing on 'at' in system or command text, and on 'in' after a bracketed number in trial results.
modes.example: dmesg | grep -i zipsd0<< at>> atapibus0 drive 1:

card.plain: It fires on the small words in computer error messages that come just before a file location or line number.
